science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: Kaio caught the glowing baton, her breath catching as another massive wave of magnetic shear slammed into the First Forge. Outside, the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea was producing impossible, beautiful geometries of force, but inside it meant the air was stiflingly hot and thick with the tang of melted ozone. She immediately moved to DEFEND the delicate primary calibration nexus, her swift fingers adjusting the dials to counter the incoming harmonic frequency. The hum of the machinery was deafening, a physical pressure against her skin, punctuated by the sharp hiss of sparks. Hoping to relieve the strain, she decided to ATTRACT some of the rogue charge by opening the secondary grounding vent. Finally, with the pressure stabilized for a brief moment, she chose to CONSUME the raw telemetry data streaming from the baton, analyzing the complex wave forms. 'Ryn, take it!' she called out, tossing the baton towards him.

horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Reinforce the First Forge against the magnetic storm.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Prevent the ferrofluid sea from breaching the lower levels.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The First Forge hums with barely contained energy as the magnetic storm rages outside. Sparks dance across the heavily insulated conduits, illuminating the room in erratic bursts of blue and gold. The air is thick with the smell of ozone and hot metal, a tangible reminder of the power harnessed within these walls.
